models.notes: Best general-purpose coding model for this stack's size class. Verified working end-to-end (RAG grounding, tool use) throughout this project's development.

Mixture-of-Experts: 30B total parameters but only ~3B active per token, so CPU inference is much faster than a dense 30B model despite the large download. Needs ~20GB+ RAM to run comfortably -- the installer warns if detected system RAM is below ram_warning_gb, but does not block the download.
Smallest model in this list. Uses a looped-transformer architecture -- confirmed loading correctly on the koboldcpp version this project pins (older llama.cpp builds do not support it).
